svg.title: An MCP host contains one MCP client per server; each server reaches its own data
svg.desc: The host is the AI app you use. It runs the language model integration and decides what the model sees. Inside the host are two MCP clients, one per server. MCP client 1 connects over stdio to a files server running as a local process on the same machine; that server reads files on your computer. MCP client 2 connects over Streamable HTTP to a weather server running as a remote service; that server calls a weather API. Solid dark lines are MCP connections. Grey lines are each server's own access to its data, which is not MCP.
